)

CREATE TABLE "public"."constructionObject" (
  "actualEndDate" date,
  "address" text,
  "archivedAt" timestamptz,
  "code" text NOT NULL,
  "contractorOrganizationId" uuid,
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "createdById" uuid NOT NULL,

CREATE TABLE "public"."customerRequirementProfile" (

  "name" text NOT NULL,

  "status" text DEFAULT 'draft' NOT NULL,
  "version" text NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "customerRequirementProfile_status_check_4757a2da" CHECK ("status" IN ('draft', 'active', 'retired'))
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."document" (
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "documentTypeId" uuid,
  "fileAssetId" uuid,
  "fileName" text NOT NULL,
  "id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "mimeType" text NOT NULL,
  "objectId" uuid NOT NULL,
  "packageId" uuid NOT NULL,
  "status" text DEFAULT 'awaiting_upload' NOT NULL,
  "typeConfidence" numeric(5,4),
  "typeEditedManually" bool DEFAULT false NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),

  "attempt" int4 DEFAULT 1 NOT NULL,
  "documentId" uuid NOT NULL,
  "errorCode" text,
  "errorMessage" text,
  "finishedAt" timestamptz,
  "id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "inputVersion" text,
  "outputVersion" text,
  "stage" text NOT NULL,
  "startedAt" timestamptz,
  "status" text DEFAULT 'pending' NOT NULL,
  "workerId" text,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),

)

CREATE TABLE "public"."documentType" (
  "active" bool DEFAULT true NOT NULL,
  "code" text NOT NULL,
  "description" text,
  "id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "name" text NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."extractedField" (
  "confidence" numeric(5,4),
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "documentId" uuid NOT NULL,
  "editedManually" bool DEFAULT false NOT NULL,
  "id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "key" text NOT NULL,
  "label" text NOT NULL,
  "originalValue" text,
  "sourceRefId" uuid,
  "updatedAt" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  "valueJson" jsonb,
  "valueText" text,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."fileAsset" (
  "bucket" text NOT NULL,
  "checksumVerified" bool DEFAULT false NOT NULL,
  "duplicateOfId" uuid,
  "id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "mimeType" text NOT NULL,
  "objectKey" text NOT NULL,
  "organizationId" uuid NOT NULL,
  "originalFileName" text NOT NULL,
  "sha256" character(64) NOT NULL,
  "sizeBytes" int8 NOT NULL,
  "storageProvider" text DEFAULT 'yandex' NOT NULL,
  "uploadedAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."finding" (
  "actual" text,
  "comment" text,
  "confidence" numeric(5,4),
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "decidedAt" timestamptz,
  "decidedById" uuid,
  "documentId" uuid NOT NULL,
  "expected" text,
  "explanation" text,
  "id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "message" text NOT NULL,
  "normRef" text,
  "objectId" uuid NOT NULL,
  "packageId" uuid NOT NULL,
  "ruleVersionId" uuid NOT NULL,
  "severity" text NOT NULL,
  "status" text DEFAULT 'open' NOT NULL,
  "updatedAt" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "finding_severity_check_38a404f1" CHECK ("severity" IN ('info', 'warning', 'error', 'critical')),
  CONSTRAINT "finding_status_check_fdbbe627" CHECK ("status" IN ('open', 'accepted', 'dismissed', 'fixed'))
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."findingHistory" (
  "comment" text,
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "findingId" uuid NOT NULL,
  "fromStatus" text NOT NULL,
  "id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "toStatus" text NOT NULL,
  "userId" uuid NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "findingHistory_fromStatus_check_e8661be2" CHECK ("fromStatus" IN ('open', 'accepted', 'dismissed', 'fixed')),
  CONSTRAINT "findingHistory_toStatus_check_ad417e61" CHECK ("toStatus" IN ('open', 'accepted', 'dismissed', 'fixed'))
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."findingSource" (

  PRIMARY KEY ("findingId", "sourceRefId")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."membership" (
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "organizationId" uuid NOT NULL,
  "role" text NOT NULL,
  "status" text DEFAULT 'invited' NOT NULL,
  "userId" uuid NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "membership_role_check_932e7473" CHECK ("role" IN ('owner', 'engineer')),
  CONSTRAINT "membership_status_check_282eda46" CHECK ("status" IN ('active', 'invited', 'disabled'))
)

  "active" bool DEFAULT true NOT NULL,
  "checksum" text,
  "code" text NOT NULL,

  "officialUrl" text,
  "sourceType" text NOT NULL,
  "storageKey" text,

CREATE TABLE "public"."objectGroup" (
  "active" bool DEFAULT true NOT NULL,
  "code" text NOT NULL,
  "description" text,
  "id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "name" text NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."objectRequirementBinding" (
  "boundAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "objectId" uuid NOT NULL,
  "requirementSetId" uuid NOT NULL,
  "workTypeId" uuid NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."objectType" (
  "active" bool DEFAULT true NOT NULL,
  "code" text NOT NULL,
  "description" text,
  "groupId" uuid NOT NULL,
  "id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "name" text NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."objectWorkType" (
  "id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "objectId" uuid NOT NULL,
  "status" text DEFAULT 'active' NOT NULL,
  "workTypeId" uuid NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."organization" (
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "kind" text NOT NULL,
  "name" text NOT NULL,
  "slug" text NOT NULL,
  "status" text DEFAULT 'active' NOT NULL,
  "updatedAt" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "organization_kind_check_d7b4a9e6" CHECK ("kind" IN ('tenant', 'counterparty')),

CREATE TABLE "public"."package" (
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "createdById" uuid NOT NULL,
  "documentsCount" int4 DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL,
  "finishedAt" timestamptz,
  "id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "objectId" uuid NOT NULL,
  "progress" numeric(5,2) DEFAULT ('0'::numeric(5,2)) NOT NULL,
  "status" text DEFAULT 'uploading' NOT NULL,
  "version" int4 NOT NULL,

CREATE TABLE "public"."rule" (
  "active" bool DEFAULT true NOT NULL,
  "code" text NOT NULL,
  "id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "name" text NOT NULL,

)

  "active" bool DEFAULT true NOT NULL,

  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
